title: Boxes of Eggs

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The hens have been busy! Look at all these eggs.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: We sell eggs in boxes of six. Will you fill the boxes, carefully?

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Put six eggs in each box. Count as you go, gently!
steps.hint: Find a box with an empty dip, and put an egg there.

older.prompt: Six eggs in each of four boxes. No dips to help: count carefully. How many eggs is that?

feedback.full: That box is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Three boxes of six: eighteen eggs, and not one cracked!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Eighteen eggs! Some for market, and some for Mr. Tobias's cakes.

journal_line: I packed eggs into boxes of six at the farm.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Four boxes of six: twenty-four eggs! That's two dozen.
